welcomeLead: Edukasaun OS is installed and ready. Before Eduka-Desktop starts, take a minute to set up your computer for learning, creating and sharing.
upstreamThanks: With thanks to Debian and the open-source community.
desktopLead: Everything from Eduka-Desktop, Eduka-Panel and Eduka-Menu in one place. Watch the preview, then press Apply.
appsLead: Choose the applications you need. You can also continue and install them later.
goalEducationBody: Bring practical digital tools to schools and learning spaces.
goalAccessBody: Promote free software and reuse suitable computers.
goalSkillsBody: Encourage Tetun, collaboration, and a local developer community.
donationBody: Your optional contribution can help development, learning resources, and community activities.
donationOptional: Edukasaun OS remains free to use.
alwaysShow: Show the Welcome Screen every time I log in
suiteDesktop: Coordinates the Edukasaun desktop experience and integrates its menu, panel, and settings.
suiteMenu: Find applications, browse categories, manage favorites, and access session and power actions.
suitePanel: Switch between running apps and access the tray, network, sound, clock, desktop, and EUS notifications.
suiteSettings: Adjust the menu layout, theme, transparency, visual effects, and desktop preferences.
purposeMonitor: Monitor CPU, memory, and running processes.
scanResult: {count} additional applications available in this catalog.
scanError: Some inventory checks failed. Installation is disabled until a complete scan succeeds.
installComplete: Installation finished. The application list will be refreshed.
installFailed: Installation failed or was cancelled. See the log for details.
consentFlathub: Add the official Flathub repository for my user account if needed.
consentBrave: Add the official Brave APT repository and signing key.
flatpakMissing: Flatpak is not installed. Install it with sudo apt install flatpak, then refresh.
desktopWarning: Settings are saved for your user account only, in the same files Eduka-Menu-Settings uses. LXQt themes and wallpaper apply in LXQt sessions.
desktopApplied: Desktop settings saved. Eduka-Panel and Eduka-Desktop refresh automatically.
effectsNote: Visual effects depend on the active compositor. Open session settings to configure it; no compositor is replaced automatically.
pendingCredits: Credits will appear when the project maintainer configures them.
closeBusy: Please wait for the current operation to finish before closing.
notInstalledApp: The required desktop tool is not installed.
purposeMathLab: Work with mathematical worksheets and installed calculation backends.
purposeLayout: Design posters, brochures and learning publications.
purposeCode: Write code with a lightweight editor.
purposePython: Learn Python with an educational development environment.
catalogFreshness: Only applications missing from this system are shown. APT availability uses local package indexes.
confirmDetail: Internet access is required. APT requests administrator authentication. Existing applications are checked again before installing.
preflightChanged: The application inventory changed. Review the refreshed list and select again.
setupOverviewBody:
1. Set the date and time zone
2. Meet the Eduka-Desktop Suite
3. Make the desktop your own
4. Add learning applications
5. Meet our sponsors
6. Join the community, then start Eduka-Desktop
timeLead: Choose your time zone. The list starts from Dili, Timor-Leste, the home of Edukasaun OS.
automaticTime: Set the time automatically from the internet (NTP)
noTimezoneMatch: No time zone matches your search.
timeApplying: Applying date and time settings… Administrator authentication may be requested.
timeFailed: The date and time could not be changed. Authentication may have been cancelled.
timedatectlMissing: timedatectl (systemd) is not available on this system.
timeNote: Time settings apply to the whole computer and require administrator authentication. The clock format is saved for Eduka-Panel.
suiteLead: Edukasaun OS is a free, open-source operating system made in Timor-Leste and based on Debian GNU/Linux. Its desktop, the Eduka-Desktop Suite, is designed for schools, students and teachers.
toolEus: Edukasaun Update Service: keeps the system up to date and notifies you through Eduka-Panel.
toolKonekta: Classroom chat over the local network, no internet required.
toolBlock: Web filtering for safer learning at school and at home.
helperMissing: Install the Edukasaun Welcome package before installing applications.
finishLead: Thank you for choosing Edukasaun OS. Learn with curiosity, create with confidence, and share what you discover.
alwaysShowNote: When unchecked, Eduka-Desktop starts directly at login. You can open the Welcome Screen again from the application menu.
edukaMissing: Eduka-Desktop is not installed in this session. Your choices are saved and used when it starts.
lowResource: Low resource mode for 512 MB RAM / older CPUs
themeNote: Liquid Glass adds translucent glass layers, tint, bright rims, blur hints and deeper shadows. It needs about 4 GB RAM and two CPU threads. Eduka-Default-Theme is the lightweight option.
showMenuText: Show the name beside the icon
followLanguage: Follow the system language when translations are available
visionAccess: High contrast, opaque panels and larger text
hearingAccess: Show network, sound and alert status as text on Eduka-Panel
orcaAccess: Orca screen reader: speak focused applications and menus
accessNote: Orca voice, rate and pitch can be adjusted later in Eduka-Menu-Settings → Accessibility.
defaultsRestored: Eduka-Desktop defaults restored. Press Apply to save them.
liquidRequirement: Liquid Glass requires at least 4 GB RAM and a processor and compositor capable of smooth transparency and blur. It uses more resources than Eduka-Default-Theme.
liquidDetected:
Detected memory: {memory} GiB
Logical CPU threads: {threads}
liquidRefused: Liquid Glass was not enabled to protect system stability.
sponsorsLead: Edukasaun OS is free for every school and student thanks to the organizations and people who support it.
becomeSponsorBody: Put your logo here and help bring free digital learning to more schools in Timor-Leste.
contributeBody: Report issues, translate, test and improve the code with the community on GitHub.
logoPlaceholderHint: This space is reserved for a sponsor.
partnerPlaceholderHint: This space is reserved for a partner.
